Algebra 1 · Unit 4: Linear Equations and Functions

Slope-Intercept Form

y = mx + b: read the slope m and y-intercept b, and use them to graph.

What you’ll learn

  • Identify slope and y-intercept from y = mx + b
  • Explain what m and b mean in context
  • Rewrite an equation in slope-intercept form

The mountain biking connection

Elevation = grade × distance + starting elevation is slope-intercept form.

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 1: Slope and Rate of Change

Map the Line

The MTB Ride Data Lab (the Slope & Linear Relationships Lab, extended): map a trail network on the coordinate plane, plot GPS and elevation data, measure slope and grade with the rise-over-run visualizer, read climbs, descents and flats, tell linear from nonlinear data, and discover y = kx at a steady pace. Includes the original slope practice bank and transfer challenge.

Level
Beginner to Advanced
Time
40-55 min
  • 6 stages
  • Mountain map and GPS plotting
  • Linked map and elevation profile
  • Rise-over-run visualizer
  • Trail profile designer
  • Ride data dashboard
  • Ultimate Ride Analysis Challenge (14)
  • Original practice bank (32)

Practices here: Identify slope and y-intercept from y = mx + b; Explain what m and b mean in context

Launch lab → Map the Line

Interactive lab · from Algebra 1: Writing Linear Equations

Frame the Line

The MTB Film Studio: produce a fictional mountain bike film and model it with linear equations. Write the budget from descriptions, points, tables and graphs, read slope-intercept and point-slope forms, graph the budget and storage models, set the production limits with domain and range, and direct the film with function notation.

Level
Beginner to Advanced
Time
45-55 min
  • 6 stages
  • Film production studio
  • Budget explorer
  • Point-slope builder
  • Vertical line test
  • Director’s dashboard
  • Film Producer Certification (12)
  • Your MTB Film production board

Practices here: Explain what m and b mean in context; Identify slope and y-intercept from y = mx + b; Rewrite an equation in slope-intercept form

Opens at: Stage 2: Understand the Budget · or start from the beginning
